name: Certitas
tagline: Institutional-grade authentication for the individual collector.
positioning: Certitas issues verifiable authenticity records for luxury handbags, watches, and sneakers—so every private sale, consignment, and resale listing carries proof a buyer can trust.

hero.h1: Proof of authenticity, issued in hours—not weeks.
hero.sub: Certitas gives individual collectors and independent resellers the same forensic authentication protocol used by auction houses. Submit an item, receive a signed digital certificate, and sell with documented provenance.

features.title: Forensic multi-point review
features.description: Every submission is inspected against stitch density, hardware tolerances, serial formats, and material spectra by two independent expert reviewers before a verdict is issued.

features.title: Signed digital certificate
features.description: Each authenticated item receives a tamper-evident certificate with a unique reference, photographs of record, and a public verification link buyers can check instantly.

features.title: Portable provenance file
features.description: Ownership, service history, and prior certificates travel with the item across every resale, so the record compounds in value instead of resetting each transaction.

features.title: 48-hour standard turnaround
features.description: Photograph submissions clear within two business days. Time-sensitive listings can be escalated for same-day review without leaving your dashboard.

features.title: Category coverage
features.description: Handbags, wristwatches, fine jewelry, and limited-release footwear—each governed by a category-specific authentication standard and revision log.

features.title: Verification for buyers
features.description: Prospective buyers scan the certificate code to confirm the item, condition grade, and current holder before any funds change hands.

testimonials.quote: I list Hermès and vintage Cartier for private clients. A Certitas certificate cut my average time-to-sale in half—buyers stop haggling on trust and start negotiating on price.
testimonials.name: Marguerite Vasseur

testimonials.quote: As an independent watch dealer, a disputed authenticity claim used to mean a chargeback. Now every piece ships with a signed record. My return rate on grey-market Rolex dropped to nearly zero.
testimonials.name: Julian Okafor

testimonials.quote: I resell limited sneakers full-time. The portable provenance file means a buyer who purchases from me can resell with the same certificate attached. That resale value keeps my listings ahead of the platform.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramachandran

homepage.footerBlurb: Certitas operates under published, versioned authentication standards for every category we cover. Certificates are cryptographically signed and independently verifiable. We are an authentication authority, not a marketplace.
